status: Applied canonical schema; workflow service limitations documented in canonical-store.md
authority: Reviewed custom SQL migrations, not this documentation export

constraints.name: canonical_captures_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((window_end IS NULL) OR (window_start IS NULL) OR (window_end >= window_start)))

constraints.name: canonical_observations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((numeric_value IS NOT NULL) OR (text_value IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: canonical_observations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((window_end IS NULL) OR (window_start IS NULL) OR (window_end >= window_start)))

views.definition:
SELECT o.id,
    o.capture_id,
    o.mapping_id,
    o.source_locator,
    o.provider_subject,
    o.metric,
    o.evidence_kind,
    o.numeric_value,
    o.text_value,
    o.currency,
    o.unit,
    o.price_basis,
    o.observed_at,
    o.window_start,
    o.window_end,
    o.quantity,
    o.sample_count,
    o.limitations,
    o.raw,
    o.supersedes_id,
    m.variant_id,
    c.provider,
    c.upstream_provider,
    c.captured_at,
    c.sample_kind,
    c.sample_limit,
    c.completeness
   FROM (((canonical_observations o
     JOIN canonical_captures c ON ((c.id = o.capture_id)))
     JOIN canonical_product_mappings m ON ((m.id = o.mapping_id)))
     JOIN canonical_variants v ON ((v.id = m.variant_id)))
  WHERE ((c.use_state = 'eligible'::text) AND (m.status = 'accepted'::text) AND (m.finish_scope = v.finish) AND (m.language_scope = v.printed_language) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM canonical_product_mappings next
          WHERE (next.supersedes_id = m.id)))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM canonical_observations next
          WHERE (next.supersedes_id = o.id)))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM canonical_source_retirements r
          WHERE (r.source_file_id = c.source_file_id)))));

SELECT l.id AS lot_id,
    l.origin_record_id,
    v.id AS variant_id,
    v.name,
    v.set_code,
    v.collector_number,
    v.finish,
    v.treatment,
    v.printed_language,
    l.condition_raw,
    l.condition_normalized,
    l.location,
    (COALESCE(sum((
        CASE
            WHEN (m.to_state = 'available'::text) THEN m.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END -
        CASE
            WHEN (m.from_state = 'available'::text) THEN m.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END)), (0)::bigint))::integer AS available_quantity,
    (COALESCE(sum((
        CASE
            WHEN (m.to_state = ANY (ARRAY['available'::text, 'reserved'::text, 'outbound'::text, 'quarantine'::text])) THEN m.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END -
        CASE
            WHEN (m.from_state = ANY (ARRAY['available'::text, 'reserved'::text, 'outbound'::text, 'quarantine'::text])) THEN m.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END)), (0)::bigint))::integer AS owned_quantity
   FROM ((canonical_lots l
     JOIN canonical_variants v ON ((v.id = l.variant_id)))
     LEFT JOIN canonical_stock_movements m ON ((m.lot_id = l.id)))
  GROUP BY l.id, v.id;
